create.name: Perdita Finn
create.bio:
Perdita Finn writes and teaches about building a working relationship with the ancestors and the dead. Her teachers have included Zen teachers, priests, spirit workers and healers, and she served an apprenticeship with the psychic Suzan Saxman; together they wrote The Reluctant Psychic. She and her husband Clark Strand, a former Zen monk, co-founded The Way of the Rose, a lay rosary fellowship centred on the divine feminine and on what they describe as ecology, not theology; their book of the same name tells how it began.

Animism, ancestor veneration and older, mother-centred traditions run through her teaching and through her books Take Back the Magic: Conversations with the Unseen World and Mothers of Magic: Summoning the Wisdom of Our Ancestors. Working with altars, ritual, oracles, dreamwork and prayer, she teaches through Zoom workshops, a year-long course called A Year of Living with the Dead, monthly gatherings for readers of her Substack, and self-paced courses on The Shift Network. Her home is in the Catskill Mountains of New York.

books.title: Take Back the Magic: Conversations with the Unseen World
books.author: Perdita Finn
books.description: Perdita Finn's account of recovering a living relationship with the dead and the unseen world. Drawing on her own life and on many conversations, she sets out practical ways to ask the ancestors for help.

books.title: Mothers of Magic: Summoning the Wisdom of Our Ancestors
books.author: Perdita Finn
books.description: A guide to reconnecting with maternal ancestors and the mother-centred spiritual traditions that came before patriarchy. It offers stories, history and practices for drawing on ancestral wisdom.

books.title: The Way of the Rose: The Radical Path of the Divine Feminine Hidden in the Rosary
books.author: Clark Strand, Perdita Finn
books.description: Clark Strand and Perdita Finn tell how a vision of Our Lady led them to found a rosary fellowship outside any church. The book reframes the rosary as a practice rooted in the divine feminine and the natural world.

books.title: The Reluctant Psychic: A Memoir
books.author: Suzan Saxman, Perdita Finn
books.description: The memoir of psychic Suzan Saxman, written with Perdita Finn, about growing up seeing spirits and learning to live with the gift. It follows her path to working as a psychic and medium.

courses.title: Collaborate With Your Ancestral Spirits to Manifest the Miraculous
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on building a relationship with the ancestral dead. It covers altars and daily ritual, making requests of the dead, oracles and animal signs, reincarnation, and working with saints and deities.

courses.title: A Year of Living with the Dead 2026–2027
courses.description: A year-long live course on Zoom, meeting weekly on Friday afternoons, for building a daily relationship with the ancestral dead. It covers rituals and mantras, oracle work, dreamwork, altars and shrines, and including the ancestors in rites of passage; sessions are recorded.

courses.title: Monthly Magic
courses.description: A monthly one-hour Zoom gathering on the third Sunday for paid subscribers to Perdita's Substack. Members share and ask about their experiences with the dead in a confidential, unrecorded space.
